annotations.text:
The move.

Today the tab opens on nine closed waves and the active one sits at ~65% of the scroll height.

Here the order is: what the plan is (summary + rail), what is running now, the longest road left, what is ahead, and history LAST — collapsed to one row per wave, no cards drawn.

Unplanned work is a measurement, not a list.

64 of 69 open tasks (93%) sit outside every wave. That figure is the health of the plan, so it leads; the tasks are reachable underneath, grouped and expandable, instead of 64 ellipsised chips.

Dependency edges: dropped, not redrawn.

The old SVG spaghetti ran behind opaque cards across a wrapping flex row and could not be followed. The relation now lives on the card ("waiting on TL-90", "unblocks TL-198") and the critical path is an explicit chain strip.

See artboard 2 for the focus interaction that replaces tracing a line by eye.

Every figure is real: taken from this repository's own backlog on 2026-09-05 with `branchling plan` and `branchling stats`. 14 waves, 41 planned tasks, 36 closed, wave 10 active, 69 open, 64 unplanned.
